aboutMe: Hi, I'm Ayberk Tığlı — a Full-Stack Developer building modern, scalable web applications with Laravel and Next.js. From corporate websites with admin panels to e-commerce and B2B platforms, I handle both the interface and the backend.
heroDescription: Full-Stack Developer building fast, SEO-friendly and user-centric web products with Laravel, Next.js and TypeScript. Passionate about clean code, problem solving and continuous learning.
myTechnicalExpertise: My technical expertise and proficiency levels
showcasingMyWork: Showcasing my work with modern web technologies
exp1Desc: Developing custom web projects with Laravel and Next.js for corporate clients, covering admin panels, e-commerce and B2B platforms, multilingual and SEO-focused sites. Responsible for the frontend architecture as well as backend work such as database design (Prisma, MySQL/PostgreSQL), authentication, payment and ERP integrations, and data imports. Also contributed to campaign pages and content management systems for Meta and Google Ads.
exp2Desc: Developed fully customized, static frontend websites using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, tailored to individual client needs within an agency setting. Focused on building clean, responsive UI structures and lightweight theme templates without admin panel functionality. This period allowed me to strengthen my core UI/UX development skills, while also managing recurring revisions based on client feedback and usability expectations.
exp3Desc: Worked on e-commerce-focused projects, primarily customizing themes on top of existing B2B and B2C infrastructures. Translated bespoke UI designs into production-ready frontend code using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and jQuery. This role was my introduction to e-commerce architecture and user journey optimization. I refined my ability to convert design files into pixel-perfect, responsive layouts and gained insight into building conversion-friendly product and checkout pages.
exp4Desc: Joined as a volunteer during my university years, marking my first professional development experience. Contributed to a TÜBİTAK-supported, environmentally focused startup by building clean and functional user interfaces. This role introduced me to real-world frontend development, where I gained hands-on experience working on a live project and began building a solid foundation in web technologies.
